terms.title: Terms & Privacy Policy
terms.section1Body:
CoopGrid ("Platform", "hum", "humara") par aapka swagat hai. CoopGrid mobile applications ya iske centralized administration interfaces ko download, install ya use karke, aap ("User", "Employer", "Worker", "Kisan", "Vyapari") in Terms and Conditions se kanooni roop se badhne ke liye sahamat hote hain. Agar aap in sharton se sahamat nahi hain, toh aapko turant app ka istemaal band karke ise uninstall kar dena chahiye.
Ye sharthein aapke hyperlocal on-demand service matching, kheti ki machinon ke kiraye aur kheti ke surplus utpadan ki matching services ke istemaal ko govern karti hain.
terms.section2Title: 2. DUAL INTERFACE IDENTITY AUR PROFILE VERIFICATION
terms.section2Body:
Account Authenticity: Users ko ek chalu mobile number se register karna hoga jiska multi-factor validation (OTP check) zaroori hai. Aap apne account ki sabhi activities ke liye khud zimmedar hain.
Verification Protocols:
Gharalu/Vyaktigat Accounts: Sarkari pehchan patra jaanch (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, ya Driving License check) ke adheen hain.
Sansthan/Corporate Accounts: Certified regulatory data jaise GSTIN, Udyam Aadhaar number, ya valid cooperative federation license dena zaroori hai.
Cooperative Workers: Sahi aur jaanchne yogya Labour Cooperative Federation membership badges aur registration upload karna hoga.
Right to Terminate: CoopGrid Administrators ke paas galat documents ya jhoothi location dene wale accounts ko freeze, reject, ya permanently delete karne ka poora adhikar hai.
terms.section3Title: 3. SERVICE DECOUPLING KI PRAKRITI AUR "INFORMATION-ONLY" MATRIX
terms.section3Body:
Hyperlocal Matching Mechanics: Standard services ke liye, CoopGrid ek on-demand proximity routing network ki tarah kaam karta hai, jo khareeddaron ko karigaron ya asset owners se jodta hai.
Agrifood Marketplace Disclaimer: Bulk kheti ke surplus faslon aur raw yields ke vyapar ke liye, CoopGrid sirf ek matchmaker aur decentralized information node ke roop me kaam karta hai.
Financial Disclaimers: CoopGrid visibility, contact links, aur dynamic location routing pradan karta hai. Platform bulk crop trades ke liye koi financial transaction, escrow system ya payment settlement process nahi karta.
Off-Platform Transactions: Baad ke sabhi cash payment, quality check grading settlement, weight measurement aur commercial pricing trades Farmer aur Buyer ke beech seedhe offline hote hain. Offline sauda hone par CoopGrid kisi bhi tarah ki kami, quality me kharabi, galat wazan ya payment me deri ke liye zimmedar nahi hoga.
terms.section4Title: 4. ON-DEMAND ROUTING, BIDDING, AUR EMERGENCY SOS MECHANISMS
terms.section4Body:
The Bidding / Expression of Interest Flow: Regular postings ke liye, employers apni service requirement broadcast karte hain. Paas ke registered workers apni interest submit karte hain. Aakhri chunav transparent peer ratings ke aadhar par Employer ka hoga. Jin workers ko skip kiya jata hai, wo broadcast ki gayi job par koi claim nahi kar sakte.
Emergency Flash Bookings (SOS): Emergency SOS system ka istemaal karne par, Platform ek automatic allocation system laagu karta hai. System employer selection screen ko bypass karke local area ke sabse pehle responder ko project assign kar deta hai. Urgent requests ke dauran users is automatic assignment model ko swaekar karte hain.
terms.section5Body:
Asset Safety: Provider App par machinery (tractors, tillers, harvesters) list karne wale kisan ye guarantee dete hain ki machinery sahi se kaam kar rahi hai, surakshit hai aur legally registered hai.
Operation Liability: Hirer (Employer App user) surakshit operation protocols ke liye zimmedar hai. CoopGrid hardware damage insurance, mechanical breakdown guarantee, ya replacement funding pradan nahi karta hai.
terms.section6Title: 6. WORKER WELFARE, MINIMUM WAGES, AUR CODE OF CONDUCT
terms.section6Body:
Fair Wage Compliance: Employers kshetriya cooperative guidelines aur local governmentdwara tay ki gayi kanooni baseline minimum wages ka paalan karne ke liye vachanbaddh hain. CoopGrid aisi applications ko reject karta hai jo aarthik shoshan karti hain.
Mutual Respect Rating: Sabhi users ko Dual Rating System ke tehat evaluate kiya jata hai. Feedback database me abuse, safety hazards, physical mistreatment ya jaanboojhkar payment na karne ki report milne par user ko grid se turant ban kar diya jayega.
terms.section7Body:
Service Limitations: CoopGrid software services ko "As-Is" aur "As-Available" aadhar par pradan karta hai. Hum complete network blackout me bina rukawat ke local operations ki guarantee nahi dete, bhale hi active local database caching features majood hon.
Liability Boundaries: Lagoo kendriya aur kshetriya kanoon ki haad tak, CoopGrid, iske regional administrators, cooperative society partners aur software development teams kisi bhi sharirikh chot, kheti ke nuksaan, aarthik nuksaan, fasal kharab hone ya cargo movement me hone wali dikkat ke liye zimmedar nahi honge.
terms.section8Body: Humare paas kisi bhi samay in sharton ko badalne, adapt karne ya poori tarah overhaul karne ka poora adhikar hai. Text updates ke baad bhi platform ka lagataar istemaal naye updated Terms and Conditions ke automatic validation ko darshata hai.
